summary: Thermo Fisher is multinational company providing scientific instrumentation, founded in 2006. Type: listed company. About 67,816 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $39.2 billion (2021). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 94% of its 49 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 4 about acquisitions; 2 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: US scientific instruments and life-sciences giant (about $40 billion yearly revenue) with 49 roles here, mostly Eindhoven or remote, 94% without Dutch.

culture.text: Of its 49 roles here, 18 are remote and 17 in Eindhoven, with others in Groningen and Tilburg.
Staff mostly studied chemistry, biology, biotechnology, biochemistry or business, and work in research, operations, IT and engineering.
Openings focus on healthcare and life sciences (12), operations and supply chain (11) and hardware engineering (8).

open.text: Thermo Fisher Scientific B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
94% of its 49 jobs here don't require Dutch, and 20% mention visa or relocation support.
Mostly experienced roles: 5 internships and 3 entry-level jobs against 13 senior and 8 director positions.

growth.text: Made US$39.2 billion revenue in 2021; its LinkedIn page now cites about $40 billion a year.
Says it sees stronger demand and calls 2026 an 'outstanding year'.
Launched Precure, a new biomedical data company, together with Mayo Clinic.

worth_knowing.text: Showcased new drug-development services and expanded capabilities at CPHI Milan 2026.
